title: A long tool call title is cut off at the screen width
body: coax draws a tool call on one line: the kind, the title and the status. A title wider than the pane is cut at the right edge, and the status goes with it. The adapter makes a Bash call's title the whole command. In a 120-column pane, a `mkdir -p ... && touch ... && git check-ignore ...` call ended at `git check-ig`, with no `done` after it.
close_reason: Fixed in "Group tool calls and restyle prompts and thoughts" on dev: `tool_line` in `src/ui.rs` cuts the title with an ellipsis to fit the pane, and the status glyph comes before the title.
